card.name: Linking words in body and cleanup procedures
card.fires_on: Small linking words, list markers or punctuation inside instructions about handling bodies, remains, crime scenes or decontamination and poisoning steps. It responds at the point where the next step or item is about to be named.

modes.label: Death investigation
modes.description: Linking word or list number in text about a body, scene or investigation.
modes.example: Police quickly declared the death a suicide and disposed of the body<< without>> further investigation.

modes.label: Treatment and cleanup steps
modes.description: Word like by or to in step-by-step handling, such as charcoal after lavage or disposal of broken items.
modes.example: This should include large volume gastric lavage followed<< by>> activated charcoal.
